title: geonoma chococola subsp. awaensis
intro: Geonoma chococola subsp. awaensis, commonly known as the "Awa Palms", is a plant species in the family Arecaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Geonoma chococola subsp. awaensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties. The plant's bioactive compounds have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions including wound healing, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular protective effects.
